WITH team_rates AS (
  SELECT
    team_id,
    AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM manager_half
  GROUP BY team_id
),
league_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_team_avg_win_rate
  FROM team_rates
)
SELECT
  team_rates.team_id,
  team_rates.avg_win_rate,
  team_rates.record_count,
  team_rates.avg_win_rate - league_mean.mean_team_avg_win_rate AS difference
FROM team_rates
CROSS JOIN league_mean
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
